notes: "This is the central idea. Every project has one Main Slides collection: the canonical, editable source. A Presentation does not copy slides; it lists references to Main Slides or to whole Sections, in whatever order that talk needs, and each appearance can carry its own speaker notes. The table on the right is real: it comes from this deck, which has a full Presentation and a shorter brief Presentation built from the same Main Slides. The same slide sits at different positions in each. When I correct a Main Slide, both talks show the correction."

designIntent.purpose: Explain one canonical Main Slides collection and several Presentations built by reference.
